card_text: Fans and heaters repaired at the shop.
title: Fan and heater repair in Bhaktapur
intro: We repair fans and heaters in-house at our shop in Sukuldhoka, Bhaktapur. Bring it to the shop and we'll check it.
how: Bring the fan or heater to the shop in Sukuldhoka.
We check it and tell you the price before any work starts.
ask: Hi, fan/heater repair bare sodhnu chha.
